Principal General Practitioner with broad experience across women's health, child health, chronic disease, mental health, and travel medicine.

field.name: bio
field.p: Dr. Rimi is an experienced General Practitioner with over nine years of practice in Australia. She has worked in a variety of general practices and regional hospitals, including rural areas in South Australia and Victoria. As a Fellow of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP), she brings a wealth of expertise and a passion for patient care.

Her special interests include Women's Health, Child Health, Chronic Diseases, Mental Health, and Travel Medicine. Dr. Rimi is skilled in managing menstrual disorders, perimenopause, menopause, post-menopause care, and family planning. She also has significant experience working with adolescent patients facing mental health issues.

In addition to her work in general practice, Dr. Rimi has experience in emergency medicine, sports medicine, and minor surgical procedures. She is particularly passionate about caring for the elderly, ensuring they receive the attention and support they deserve.

Outside of work, Dr. Rimi enjoys spending time with her family, including her two young children and elderly parents, whom she personally cares for. She loves cooking, exploring different cuisines and reading books.

Our physiotherapy service is managed by Nirav Sanjanwala from Go Run Go Physio, with a practical, evidence-based focus on musculoskeletal, sports, spinal, and rehabilitation care.

field.name: bio
field.p: Our physiotherapy service is managed by Nirav Sanjanwala from Go Run Go Physio.

According to Go Run Go Physio, Nirav is a qualified physiotherapist with over two decades of experience as a private practitioner. He holds a Physiotherapy Degree and a Post Graduate Diploma of Physiotherapy in Musculo-Skeletal from the University of Melbourne.

His work focuses on evidence-based assessment, treatment, and rehabilitation for sports and spinal conditions, along with neurological and orthopaedic presentations. The Go Run Go Physio service also highlights support for acute and chronic musculoskeletal conditions, post-surgical rehabilitation, neck and low back injuries, and tailored recovery planning.
Nirav's approach is collaborative and outcome-focused, with the goal of helping patients move better, regain function, and build confidence in their recovery.

Our podiatry service is provided by Stephen Devenish from LiveWell Podiatry, supporting foot and lower-limb care with a focus on function, comfort, and long-term mobility.

field.name: bio
field.p: Our podiatry service is provided by Stephen Devenish from LiveWell Podiatry.

LiveWell Podiatry describes Stephen as the owner and podiatrist who is passionate about helping people get back on their feet and return to the things they love, whether that is sport, time with grandkids, or everyday mobility.

The service covers podiatry issues affecting the feet and lower limbs, including nails, callouses and corns, warts, ingrown nails, diabetes foot health assessments, heel pain, sports injuries, children's feet, and gait or running assessments.

LiveWell Podiatry also notes that Stephen bulk bills eligible EPC/Medicare, DVA, and TAC referrals, provides home visits in the Carrum Downs, Seaford, and Frankston area, and seeks to address the cause of the issue rather than offering only a short-term fix.
